title: A syntactically valid reply missing a required field is refused, not defaulted

input.model_reply_raw: {"headline": "Leverage ratio breach dated 2026-08-04", "summary": "Leverage ratio stands at 3.25x against a threshold of 3.00x.", "drivers": ["Leverage ratio"], "recommended_next_step": "Not available from the recorded evidence."}

reasons: reply is missing required field(s): disclaimer

note: The reply is valid JSON but omits 'disclaimer', one of _reply_shape_failures's five required fields (headline, summary, drivers, recommended_next_step, disclaimer). A missing mandatory disclaimer is never filled in with a default sentence on the caller's behalf -- the whole draft is refused so the one permitted regeneration can be told exactly what to add.
